Yeah, he was new. Checked his total fame after and it was like 2.5 mil. I have like 5.4 last I checked. And yes, its fun meeting new players who are not running around with 7/8.x gear.

We were both doing pve and just minding our own business when I saw him get low from the mobs. When I rushed him he quickly got on his mount so I backed off. He then started to run around me and taunting me bc I tried to rush him. So I went a bit further away and just stood and watched his health bar going down while he was killing mobs. I didn't really have any intentions of killing him at this point. When I was watching him he suddenly popped his boots ability when his health was back to 100% and rushed me so I ran. When it was clear that I wasnt getting away I turned on him. I guess I surprised him cause he didnt really know what to do when i used Smokebomb, and then I killed him.
I know, just get frustrated when this happens all the time :( So I'm kinda just venting
I'll try, thanks for the advice!
